key_insight: TATVA formulates quantum circuit synthesis as a reinforcement learning search over gate sequences to automatically generate high-fidelity target states with compact circuits.
engineering_relevance: The framework could reduce manual circuit design effort for quantum state preparation, which is a foundational step in practical quantum computing workflows.
method: Uses two RL agents in parallel: Deep Q-Network (DQN) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).
Applies gates sequentially and evaluates fidelity after each step to choose the best circuit action.
Includes post-hoc optimization to reduce circuit depth while preserving achieved fidelity.
evidence_signal: According to the abstract, the system synthesizes circuits for up to 5 qubits, reaches fidelity as high as 0.999999, and is evaluated on target states not seen during training to assess generalization.
watch_item: Performance is reported only up to 5 qubits, so scalability and robustness on larger circuits may be limited or unproven.
paper_title: TATVA: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Quantum Circuit Synthesis
